text:
nina: heads up — prototype for the playground run history. the function/tool call line currently dumps full args. proposing a compact "summary + expand" pattern so rows stay legible. omar: big +1. hover-only previews are brittle on touch. prefer an explicit toggle button so it's discoverable. keep the visible label very short (one word). lucy: microcopy candidates: "Preview", "Value", "Open". my vote: "Preview" because it's neutral and localizes well. avoid punctuation. omar: accessibility checklist: toggle must be a button with aria-expanded, aria-controls pointing at the panel, and the panel should have role=region and aria-labelledby. when opened move focus to the panel heading and announce "Expanded argument preview for ". Escape should collapse and restore focus. do NOT trap focus. nina: visual idea: show type + size inline when value is complex (e.g., "object (3)", "array (8)") and render a tiny chevron for state. animate only opacity to prevent layout shifts. lucy: UX note: move the copy-to-clipboard action into the row actions (outside the panel) to reduce accidental copies. put a small tooltip on the copy button for screen readers: "Copy sample value for ". devops-bot: CI deploy status: playground-ui/stage passed. omar: telemetry thought: emit an event when users open previews so we can measure usage. if less than a threshold (say 1%) we can hide the affordance under a contextual menu for dense timelines. nina: quick pseudo markup to share with engineers: ```
user_email

Argument preview: user_email (string)

"j.user@example.com"
``` lucy: keep the button label under 12 chars for localization headroom and avoid verbs like "fetch" that imply network. use the single-character ellipsis (…) for truncation. omar: QA checklist: keyboard open/close, screen reader announce, focus restoration, mobile tap target >=44px, no virtualization regressions. I'll add to the ticket. design-bot: Created ticket PL-4411 "Run history: compact arg summary + explicit toggle" — https://go/redwood/PL-4411 nina: next steps: i'll update the mock with "Preview" label + chevron and add the type/size hint. lucy please add the copy variants and loc notes to PL-4411; omar add the a11y checklist and telemetry event. sync 20m if anyone's free. :slightly_smiling_face:
